Greetings!

Yeah, so a plugin I installed BROKE shulkerboxes and DIDN'T EVEN FIX THE ISSUE. Also the spawners from the last update didn't work...

BUT NOW IT WORKS. I just had to re-work the entire system, but yah-know, I'm doing GREAT. No annoyance here! NONE!

ANYWAY, I fixed all those issues and I improved the spawners.

---Spawner Improvments---
-Works
-You can now use [USE KEY] to remove the spawner and get the item back! How lovely! ITS SO BEAUTIFUL.

---Bug Fixes---
-Fixed bug caused by plugin
-Fixed the Spawners

This server has taken a toll on me for this past update, so I'm going to take a break for a bit. You can keep sending in your ideas and bug reports (That NO ONE fills out)!

I hope you enjoy the new update!
-Toadec
